Discover this Unique Opportunity for your Business in El Raval with InmoOlaya!

We present this premises with a C1 license in the vibrant Plaza Josep Folch, one of the busiest and most emblematic areas of the city. With a privileged location, this charming space is ready to become the heart of your next venture.

Highlighted Features:

Strategic Location: Located in the lively Plaza Josep Folch, the premises enjoys excellent visibility and easy pedestrian access, making it an ideal destination for local customers and tourists alike.
Large Outdoor Terrace: With capacity for three outdoor tables, the terrace is an invaluable asset that allows you to take advantage of the Mediterranean climate and attract more customers throughout the year.
Generous Capacity: With capacity to accommodate up to 25 people, the premises is perfect for informal meetings, social gatherings and private events, guaranteeing a welcoming experience for your customers.
Affordable Rent: With a monthly rent of only 920 euros, this is a profitable opportunity to launch or expand your business in a privileged location without incurring excessive costs.
Complete Transfer: The transfer of 100,000 euros includes furniture, equipment and an established clientele, guaranteeing a smooth transition and allowing you to start operating immediately.
Ideal for a variety of businesses, from cafes and pastry shops to tapas bars and informal restaurants, this premises offers endless possibilities to make your business vision a reality.

Don't miss this golden opportunity to bring your business to life in one of the most coveted locations in the city! Contact us today to schedule a visit and discover the full potential this premises has to offer.

Rental Price: 920 euros/month

Transfer Price: 100,000 euros

InmoOlaya is here to help you make your business dreams a reality.
